title: Why Do We See Reflections?
hook: Smooth stuff can bounce light like a trampoline.
narration: Smooth stuff can bounce light like a trampoline.
This 3D Short is only about this: Why Do We See Reflections.
A mirror is glass with a shiny metal back.
Let me show you that in 3D.
Still water can act like a weak mirror.
Watch this next bit closely. This is why it happens.
Ripples scramble the bounce, so the face breaks up.
So the idea is simple: cause, then effect.
Remember: Smooth stuff can bounce light like a trampoline.
The pictures today are a new water world. Not yesterday's film.
That is the whole idea, in one short 3D film.
Stay to the end. The last shot is the takeaway for why do we see reflections.
Tomorrow a brand new 3D film. Same curious science. Brand new pictures.
